saw_lines: Bag buyers want one bag that looks new every week, so they judge it by how many looks it gives.
So the sale is won in the first line, where a buyer decides if this bag looks new to them.
Your 8 of 20 copy ads open on one brown line, so name 2 or 3 new angles from your product and test each against it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 20 Oct 2026
points: 8 of 20 copy ads open on the same brown line, so one opener carries most of the account. Name 2 or 3 new angles from your product, like the swap clip and the Mini Me size, and test each against it.
The same copy runs in 8 of 20 ads, so viewers see one story again and again. Keep the body copy, swap the opening line and the creative in each ad, so repeats feel new to people scrolling past.
None of the 30 ads shows a proof number, so buyers have nothing concrete to trust. Collect one figure, such as your review count or orders shipped, and open the next ads with it on the creative.
0 of 20 copy ads carry an offer, so a new buyer has no reason to act today. Add one first order offer or a bundle and put it in the first line of three new ads.
